title: The 9 Best Floodlight Cameras
subtitle: Wi-Fi security cameras with built-in floodlights for driveways and backyards, ranked.
intro: We pulled the floodlight cameras on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: video resolution, light brightness, local storage, and whether recordings need a subscription.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

scoring.review_age_weighting: Listings under 24 months old with at least 30 reviews have their review count multiplied by min(2, 24 / age in months, age floored at 6) before scoring; older listings are unchanged. Listing age is Amazon's Date First Available, or an estimate from the ASIN when the listing does not show it.

buyers_guide.q: Floodlight camera or regular outdoor camera?
buyers_guide.a: A floodlight camera adds bright motion-activated lights, which light up a driveway or backyard and give color night video. It usually replaces an existing outdoor light fixture, so it's hardwired.
Most mount on a junction box in place of an existing light. Some plug into an outdoor outlet, and a few run on batteries and solar panels, with dimmer lights.
It depends on the brand. Ring and Arlo keep recorded video behind a plan; eufy, Reolink, and some others record to local storage for free. Each listing's fee notes are in its pros and cons.
